data.body:
[P2] Bound residual-task shutdown before producing reports

The coordinator deliberately stops waiting for adapter tasks that exceed their budgets and quarantines the affected targets. However, `asyncio.run()` subsequently cancels and waits for every remaining task without a timeout. An adapter task that continues suppressing cancellation therefore hangs the CLI after collection returns, preventing `build_report()` and report-file publication despite the configured harness limits. Use an explicitly bounded shutdown path that preserves quarantine and allows reporting to finish. Add a CLI regression test with an adapter task that survives repeated cancellation.
